instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:typecheck (the file's own vitest run passes; only tsc fails), 4 errors, the same at each site: packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx(384,32), (386,32), (393,32), (395,32): error TS2322: Type 'Readonly<{ id: string; x: number; ... }> & Readonly<...> & ...' is not assignable to type 'NonDeletedExcalidrawElement'. The sites are the `API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(arrow)])`, `API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(tgt)])` (twice) and `API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(src2)])` calls in the arrowhead size paste-styles part: API.getElement returns the UI.createElement proxy type, while API.setSelectedElements takes NonDeletedExcalidrawElement[]. Fix by casting each argument element: `API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(arrow) as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement]);`, with `NonDeletedExcalidrawElement` added to the existing `import type { ... } from "@excalidraw/element/types";` (or a new type import of it from there). Also make case (b) match AC-8 exactly: before pasting from src2 (which has no arrowheadSize), give the target arrowheadSize 0.5, not 1.5: select the target and run `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeArrowheadSize, "ui", 0.5); });`, assert it is 0.5, then select src2, copy styles, select the target, paste styles, and assert the target's arrowheadSize is undefined and `"arrowheadSize" in` the target is false. Change nothing else; every other assertion already passes. Do not use Keyboard.undo/redo (this file renders without handleKeyboardGlobally).

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
